$comment: Plugin code that compensates for a bb defect. `bun scripts/workarounds.ts check` probes the installed bb; `remove <id>` deletes an entry's files and marked blocks. See AGENTS.md, bb workarounds.

workarounds.defect: bb lays out the floating thread context card (float, 312px chat shift, or banner) from the chat width in a ResizeObserver, one React render after a width change. A width snap shows one frame with the stale card and shift.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/monokai && bun run generate:theme && bun run check && bun run test
workarounds.verify: With the right panel's context card pinned, open and close the panel at 1440, 1512, 1920, 2560, and 3440px wide: nothing in the chat may move after the first frame.

workarounds.defect: bb sets the unregistered, inheriting --secondary-swipe-width on the right panel's <aside> when the panel opens or closes and around a divider drag (0.48.1 stopped the per-frame drag writes, get-bb/bb#6511). Each write restyles every element in the panel: with 2,353 elements, open and close frames reach 67–150 ms without the registration and 33–67 ms with it.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/monokai && bun run check && bun run test
workarounds.verify: Remove the @property rule and fill the right panel to about 2,300 elements (a busy GitButler tab). Open and close the panel and drag its divider: worst frames stay at or under the with-rule figures in `defect`.

workarounds.defect: bb's source viewer (@pierre/diffs VirtualizedFile before 1.3.0) keeps a blank placeholder after being hidden with display:none and shown again.
workarounds.manual: Replace each SourceView with bb's HostSourceCode in plugins/genui/ui/components/code.tsx and FrameFooter.tsx, then delete SourceView, useTimesHidden, and their tests.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/genui && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: Collapse and reopen a Code or Snippet block in a GenUI card: the source lines are drawn when it reopens.
